summary.text: Park Heights, also called the Heights, is the glamorous top level of New Capenna, with terraced gardens and the Maestros' museum, and it is the location of Henzie's candy shop.

bio.text: The material records no events for Park Heights beyond Henzie's shop being on the Heights.

status.text: A 2026 page says Park Heights fell during the Invasion, though no event in the material details it.
